'''Kestas Rone''', callsign '''Bloodletter''', was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] as [[Starfighter/Legends|Starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]]. Kestas commanded the starfighter squadron of the [[Razor Shyracks]] and was [[Death/Legends|killed]] in the [[Battle of Javaal]].
